A cinematic wide shot opens on a 19-year-old Chinese female assassin in a black dragon-totem night-crawler outfit and a 19-year-old Chinese man in a West Factory eunuch uniform standing in a moonlit palace corridor. First, the man steps forward, planting his long staff firmly on the ground with a thud, his eyes filled with suppressed hurt as he says, 你每次都这样，永远只顾着自己，从来没想过我。 Then, the camera pans quickly to the woman who scoffs, her eyes glistening with unshed tears as she retorts, 我没想过你？那这些日子我算什么？你倒说说，我哪件事没顾及你？ As the man’s grip on the staff tightens, his shoulders shaking, he exclaims, 你顾及过吗？你做决定永远先斩后奏，问都不问我一声，在你心里我到底算什么？ Before the woman steps into his personal space, her voice trembling with rage, 我不问你，是因为每次跟你说你都不耐烦，要么敷衍要么反对，我还怎么跟你商量？ The man looks away, his throat bobbing, and mutters, 我不耐烦是有原因的，你从来不肯听我解释，只会一味指责我。 As the woman laughs bitterly, shaking her head, 我不听？是你根本懒得解释！你永远觉得自己没错，错的全是我，对吧？ The man turns back, his face pained, saying, 我没说全是你的错，但你能不能别这么冲动，凡事讲点道理？ The woman steps back, gesturing wildly at the empty corridor, 讲道理？你跟我讲过道理吗？你只会冷暴力，只会沉默，让我一个人在这儿胡思乱想。 Then the man steps closer, his voice dropping to a desperate whisper, 我沉默是不想跟你吵，不是不在乎你，你非要逼得大家都难堪才开心？ The woman pushes his shoulder, her voice breaking, 我逼你？是你先把我推开的！你心里根本就没把我放在第一位，从来都没有。 Finally, the man sighs, his posture collapsing into cold indifference as he turns his back, 你非要这么想我也没办法，你爱怎么说就怎么说吧。 The woman stands frozen in the moonlight, her silhouette sharp against the stone wall, whispering, 好，既然你这么无所谓，那我们也没什么好说的了，就这样吧。 The camera shakes slightly throughout to emphasize the emotional instability, panning left and right between their faces, capturing the realistic skin textures and the shimmering moonlight on their period costumes.
